rows.heading: 1. Global state and save format (143-425)
rows.mechanism: Large lifetime counter bag (kills, money gained, deaths, time at home, cat pats, shop buys) that later feeds titles and milestones.
rows.reason: Schema 3 preserves old accounts; historical home time and purchases default to zero, not fabricated. Two public goals use native observed minutes and settled trade quantities.

rows.heading: 3. Titles (431-880, plus unlock tables 7262-7304 and giveTitle 13760)
rows.mechanism: Title earn moment is a visible event: grant, set as current title, announce once.
rows.reason: Configured native title events reuse the existing cue, compact styling, dismissal and effects settings. Restores emit no event. Existing all-held title bonuses remain derived; no separate equipped-title system.

rows.heading: 5. Effects (972-1423; plumbing at 10774-10794, 13864)
rows.mechanism: Damage-over-time effects (poison, venom, bleeding, food poisoning) each train a matching resistance skill as they tick, tying status effects to the skill economy.
rows.reason: Existing clawed guardian applies stackable native Bleeding. Played exposure trains existing Iron skin, a bodily-defense adaptation. Food-poison training from C2 is retained, not duplicated.

rows.heading: 7. Quests (1590-1683; givers 11939-12320)
rows.mechanism: Wait-out-a-shift repeatable quest: accept in a morning window, stand until evening, small pay plus Patience XP and rare passerby coins.
rows.reason: Morning acceptance, idle Village watch through 20:00, native money and skill settlement, visible closed reason and repeated next-day shifts. Existing Persistence substitutes for a new Patience skill.

rows.heading: 2. Time
rows.mechanism: Daily and weekly plan hooks: a once-per-day/week registry runs vendor restock, rat infestations and small events.
rows.reason: One weekly market stall restocks a persisted free bread claim and displays the next occurrence. Existing daily bread and native trader restock retain their owners; no second clock or catch-up registry.

rows.heading: 4. Map graph and location catalog
rows.mechanism: Unlock-by-reading-a-pamphlet and random sub-visibility (Shady Kid 15%, pamphlet 40%) make the hub feel discovered.
rows.reason: One capped 40% arrival roll, deferred until idle, retains the courier after meeting. Pamphlet reveals relay actions in the location list without bypassing native mill travel permission. No new map location is invented.

rows.heading: 5. NPCs, dialogue and quest hooks
rows.mechanism: Parcel relay errand across several NPCs that doubles as a map tour; one mentor tells you what to do next.
rows.reason: Three explicit existing-NPC handoffs with ordinary Village/mill travel, a next-stop Quest card, paid final receipt, explicit repeat and elder guidance. Existing quest presentation and Local life settlement remain the owners.

rows.heading: 6. Scouting and discovery
rows.mechanism: Search tells you whether anything remains ("you sense something" / "nothing of interest left").
rows.reason: The existing search row states one remaining find or zero/nothing remains, and disables exhausted search. Find quantities and chance are unchanged.

straddlingRows.reason: The unearned title-goal portion already existed in 73519a0a. The row’s nextSlice is exact held-copy condition/repair cost, primarily equipment UI, so this lane does not claim that row.
